articles.title: Russia Hacked Routers to Steal Microsoft Office Tokens
articles.summary: Microsoft drops 167 patches including a SharePoint zero-day and Windows Defender's 'BlueHammer' weakness. Chrome's fourth zero-day this year proves the bug apocalypse is accelerating faster than anyone wants to admit.

articles.title: Anti-DDoS Firm Heaped Attacks on Brazilian ISPs
articles.summary: Canvas gets pwned nationwide, turning America's classrooms into a cybercrime group's ransom playground. Nothing says 'back to school' like having your education infrastructure held hostage by script kiddies.

articles.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: AI-Powered Phishing, Android Spying Tool, Linux Exploit, GitHub RCE & More
articles.summary: Instructure breach claims 280 million student records from 8,809 schools stolen. When your learning management system becomes a data hemorrhage management system, maybe it's time to go back to chalkboards.

articles.title: Ivanti EPMM CVE-2026-6973 RCE Under Active Exploitation Grants Admin-Level Access
articles.summary: Linux kernel's 'Dirty Frag' LPE vulnerability gives root access across major distros. Because apparently Copy Fail wasn't catastrophic enough, here's its nastier successor that nobody's patched yet.

articles.title: PCPJack Credential Stealer Exploits 5 CVEs to Spread Worm-Like Across Cloud Systems
articles.summary: Ivanti EPMM RCE under active exploitation grants admin access to mobile endpoints. Ivanti continues its legendary streak of turning enterprise security products into attacker playground equipment.

articles.title: After Replacing TeamPCP Malware, 'PCPJack' Steals Cloud Secrets
articles.summary: EFF channels NSA whistleblower William Binney's warning about 'turnkey totalitarianism.' The surveillance empire is already built—now we just need to prevent the wrong people from finding the keys.

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, April 2026 Edition
articles.summary: Scattered Spider's 'Tylerb' pleads guilty to wire fraud and identity theft in 2022 SIM-swap campaigns. Another cybercrime legend learns that elite hacking skills don't include immunity from federal prosecution.

articles.title: One Click, Total Shutdown: The "Patient Zero" Webinar on Killing Stealth Breaches
articles.summary: PCPJack credential stealer exploits 5 CVEs to worm across cloud systems, evicting TeamPCP malware like a digital gentrification project. Even malware has real estate disputes now.

articles.title: Skeptical Science New Research for Week #19 2026
articles.summary: PAN-OS critical RCE actively exploited since April 9th, giving attackers root access to Palo Alto firewalls. When your security appliance becomes the attack vector, irony officially dies.

articles.title: Milestone 1.0.0 Release of APK Downloader `apkeep` Powers Research on Android Apps
articles.summary: Russian military intelligence mass-harvests Microsoft Office tokens by exploiting ancient router vulnerabilities. Putin's hackers prove that yesterday's forgotten firmware is today's state-sponsored espionage goldmine.
